title: Jaguars humiliate Colts in a 42-7 home win

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jaguars humiliate Colts in a 42-7 home win
sources.description: The Colts signaled a willingness to quit on their season by trading guard Quenton Nelson and defensive tackle DeForest Buckner this week and the rest of the team showed they are more than willing to take a knee on Sunday.
